titleEn: Breathe with the Waves and Let Go!

pages.text: "Twenty-three, twenty-four..." Riri in her yellow hat lined shells up by size on the sand. Sweat dotted her forehead. "The biggest goes at the very end."
Lolo splashed over from the shore. "Riri, look at the waves!" Yellow boots stepped across the shell line. Shells scattered everywhere.
Riri's face turned red. "I have been arranging them all morning!" She kicked the sand hard. Lolo flinched and stepped back.
Mom came in her blue apron and sat beside Riri. "Riri, is your chest hot now?" Riri rubbed her eyes with the back of a paw and nodded.
"Look at the waves. They come in and go out, right?" Mom placed a hand on Riri's tummy. "When a wave comes, breathe in through your nose. When it goes, breathe out through your mouth."
A wave came in. Riri breathed in through her nose, tummy rounding. It went out. She breathed slowly out through her mouth. "Breathe with the waves and let go!" Her hot cheeks cooled.
After the third wave, her fists relaxed and opened. Riri looked at Lolo. "I am sorry I shouted." Lolo ran straight over and held her hand.
They sat side by side, arranging shells again. Lolo gathered them; Riri lined them up by size. "It is all right if you step on them again. We can put them back." Riri smiled.
Riri held up three fingers. "One, wave in, breathe in! Two, wave out, breathe out! Three, do it three times, then speak!" She placed the biggest shell at the end.
Mom stroked Riri's back and hugged her tightly. "Anger comes and goes like waves too." Riri smiled at Lolo. "Breathe with the waves and let go!"
